first_attack_family.name: MIXED_AFFINE_OR3_INTERLEAVE
first_attack_family.design: start from sparse affine/expander-code constraints that are compact under Gaussian elimination, then inject preregistered OR_3 gadgets that couple independent affine sectors
first_attack_family.goal: test whether the proposed symbolic language remains closed under exact elimination without generating superpolynomial representation size
first_attack_family.forbidden_tuning: do not alter the symbolic grammar after seeing the first hostile family result

success_gate: one fixed symbolic grammar plus polynomial algorithms for normalization, conjunction, elimination, witness reconstruction and independent UNSAT replay for every OR_3+PAIR input
failure_gate: freeze a family for which the preregistered grammar requires superpolynomial representation/intermediate count or loses exact closure
